name: CodyFix
description: AI-powered CI/CD assistant that analyzes failed Jenkins builds, recommends fixes, applies code changes, and triggers rebuilds automatically through natural language conversation.

workflows.name: GetJenkinsJobsSummary
workflows.description: Fetches and analyzes Jenkins build logs, categorizes tests into passed and failed

workflows.name: FailedJobsFixRecommendations
workflows.description: Analyzes failed tests and generates actionable fix recommendations

workflows.name: WriteCodeFixes
workflows.description: Applies recommended fixes to the codebase and commits changes

workflows.name: TriggerJenkinsBuild
workflows.description: Triggers a new Jenkins build to validate applied fixes

features: Modular workflows - use together or independently
